title: Saying what was not done: agentless sentences

sections.title: What you know
sections.content: You know how to say what happened without naming the doer, with the third person plural (*megtagadták*, *nem fizették be*), from B2 Unit 15.

sections.title: What is new
sections.content: This lesson adds the words of constitutional resistance (*alkotmányos jogfolytonosság*, *passzív ellenállás*, *oktrojált rendelet*, *önkényuralom*). Passive resistance means that people use no violence but do not carry out an unlawful order: *A törvénytelen rendeletet nem hajtották végre.* Deák Ferenc (1803–1876) is the best-known Hungarian name linked with this way of acting in the 1860s.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A törvénytelen rendeletet nem hajtották végre.
The unlawful decree was not carried out.
Az adót nem fizették be, de fegyvert sem fogtak.
The tax was not paid, but no weapons were taken up either.
Cooperation was refused in the offices.
